card.name: Linking words before folate rescue drugs
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "or", "and" and "of" right after folic acid, vitamin B12 or "administration", where leucovorin or folinic acid is likely to come next. Seen in methotrexate and pemetrexed labels.
